l4_steps.name: Review headcount plan and identify vacancy
l4_steps.input: Annual headcount plan, attrition report, operational demand signal
l4_steps.output: Approved headcount request with cost centre and FTE count
l4_steps.kpi: Requisition-to-plan alignment rate ≥95%; headcount request raised within 5 business days of vacancy identification
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP SuccessFactors Workforce Planning module is not integrated with crew scheduling or flight operations staffing models — frontline vacancy data (pilots, cabin crew) must be manually cross-referenced, causing 5–10 day lag in requisition initiation

l4_steps.name: Create and submit job requisition
l4_steps.input: Approved headcount request, job description template library
l4_steps.output: Job requisition record with grade, salary band, required certifications, and target start date
l4_steps.kpi: Requisition submitted within 3 business days of headcount approval
l4_steps.pain_point: Job description templates in SAP SuccessFactors are frequently outdated for technical aviation roles (avionics technician, line maintenance engineer) — manual SME review adds 2–4 days to requisition creation

l4_steps.name: Approve requisition and confirm budget
l4_steps.system: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting / SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI/CO)
l4_steps.input: Submitted job requisition, departmental FTE budget report from SAP S/4HANA
l4_steps.output: Approved requisition with confirmed cost centre and salary band ceiling
l4_steps.kpi: Approval cycle time ≤3 business days; 100% of approved requisitions within sanctioned FTE budget
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP S/4HANA Finance month-end close (3-day window) freezes cost centre commitments — operational hiring requisitions submitted during close are delayed, disrupting crew and maintenance staffing timelines

l4_steps.name: Post vacancy to internal and external channels
l4_steps.system: SAP SuccessFactors Career Site / LinkedIn Job Slots / Indeed
l4_steps.input: Approved requisition; internal mobility policy (minimum 5-day internal posting window)
l4_steps.output: Live job posting across internal portal and external job boards; application tracking link active
l4_steps.kpi: Internal application rate ≥20% for non-entry-level roles; posting live within 1 business day of requisition approval
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP SuccessFactors Career Site apply-flow is not mobile-optimised — pilot and cabin crew candidates applying via mobile devices report high abandonment rates, reducing application conversion vs. competitor portals

l4_steps.name: Source passive candidates via direct outreach
l4_steps.system: LinkedIn Recruiter / Avjobs Aviation Job Board
l4_steps.input: Role requirements, skills profile, talent pool database in SAP SuccessFactors
l4_steps.output: Shortlisted passive candidate profiles with initial interest confirmation
l4_steps.kpi: Passive candidate pipeline of ≥3 qualified prospects per requisition within 10 business days of posting
l4_steps.pain_point: Global commercial pilot shortage (ICAO forecasts 50,000+ deficit by 2030) makes passive sourcing for ATP-rated First Officers intensely competitive — response rates on LinkedIn Recruiter InMail for pilot roles average <15%, well below the 35% cross-industry benchmark

l4_steps.name: Assess pipeline adequacy and decide sourcing strategy
l4_steps.input: Number of qualified applicants vs. minimum threshold (5 per requisition)
l4_steps.output: Go/no-go decision: proceed to screening or extend sourcing window / engage recruitment agency
l4_steps.kpi: Minimum 5 qualified applicants before screening commences; agency engagement escalation rate ≤15% of requisitions
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP SuccessFactors does not enforce a preferred supplier list for recruitment agencies — when pipeline fails, hiring managers independently engage agencies at non-negotiated rates, inflating cost-per-hire for technical roles by 30–50%

l4_steps.name: Automated ATS screening and shortlisting
l4_steps.input: All submitted applications against minimum qualification criteria
l4_steps.output: Ranked shortlist of candidates meeting mandatory requirements
l4_steps.kpi: ATS screen-to-shortlist ratio ≤5:1; screening completed within 2 business days of application close
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP SuccessFactors AI screening does not recognise FAA-standard licence abbreviations (ATP, A&P, IA) and ICAO type rating codes — qualified pilot and maintenance candidates are incorrectly filtered out, requiring manual review of up to 30% of rejections

l4_steps.name: Conduct telephone or video pre-screen interview
l4_steps.input: ATS-generated shortlist; structured pre-screen question guide
l4_steps.output: Completed pre-screen scorecard per candidate; advance or reject recommendation
l4_steps.kpi: Pre-screen completed within 5 business days of shortlisting; candidate pass rate 50–70%
l4_steps.pain_point: HireVue asynchronous video interviews have significantly lower engagement rates with experienced pilot and senior maintenance candidates who expect direct recruiter interaction — completion rates for these cohorts are 20–25% below junior role benchmarks

l4_steps.name: Administer role-specific skills and aptitude assessments
l4_steps.system: Criteria Corp (cognitive/aptitude) / SHL (technical assessment) / CAE SimuFlite (pilot simulator check)
l4_steps.input: Pre-screen pass list; role-specific assessment battery defined by HR and technical SMEs
l4_steps.output: Assessment scores; simulator evaluation report for pilot roles; advance/reject per candidate
l4_steps.kpi: Assessment completion rate ≥85%; cognitive benchmark score ≥65th percentile for technical roles; pilot sim check pass rate reported within 5 days
l4_steps.pain_point: Simulator assessment slots at CAE and FlightSafety International facilities cost $3,000–$5,000 per candidate and must be booked 4–6 weeks in advance — scheduling constraints extend pilot time-to-hire by 3–6 weeks vs. non-technical roles

l4_steps.name: Review assessments and finalise interview shortlist
l4_steps.input: Assessment scores, pre-screen scorecards, technical SME evaluation notes
l4_steps.output: Approved interview shortlist of 3–5 candidates per role with documented rationale
l4_steps.kpi: Interview shortlist delivered to hiring manager within 3 business days of assessment completion
l4_steps.pain_point: Inconsistent scoring rubrics across business units in SAP SuccessFactors create EEOC/OFCCP audit risk — selection decisions for cabin crew base hiring lack standardised documentation, exposing the airline to disparate impact claims

l4_steps.name: Schedule panel interviews and notify participants
l4_steps.system: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting / Microsoft Outlook (calendar integration)
l4_steps.input: Approved interview shortlist; panel interviewer availability
l4_steps.output: Confirmed interview schedule; candidate and interviewer calendar invitations with structured guide
l4_steps.kpi: Interviews scheduled within 5 business days of shortlist approval; candidate no-show rate ≤5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Outlook-to-SuccessFactors calendar sync fails for interviewers on crew scheduling systems — operational disruptions (IROPS, maintenance delays) cause same-day cancellations that are not automatically reflected in SuccessFactors, requiring manual rescheduling

l4_steps.name: Conduct structured panel interviews
l4_steps.role: Hiring Manager / HR Business Partner / Technical SME
l4_steps.system: SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting (interview guide and scorecard)
l4_steps.input: Competency framework, structured interview guide, candidate application and assessment results
l4_steps.output: Completed interview scorecard per panellist per candidate
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of interviews completed with documented scorecards; inter-rater reliability ≥0.70 (Krippendorff's alpha)
l4_steps.pain_point: Operational interviewers (crew planning managers, maintenance supervisors) frequently bypass SAP SuccessFactors scorecard entry citing system complexity — undocumented decisions create material gaps in EEOC record-keeping required for airlines with federal contracts

l4_steps.name: Debrief panel, rank candidates, and select preferred hire
l4_steps.input: Completed scorecards, assessment results, reference check summaries
l4_steps.output: Selected candidate with documented rationale; ranked reserve list for offer decline scenario
l4_steps.kpi: Debrief completed within 2 business days of final interview; offer decline reserve conversion rate ≥60%
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP SuccessFactors does not support structured calibration sessions for multi-site roles — regional hiring panels for cabin crew bases (e.g., BWI vs. MDW) use inconsistent evaluation norms, creating equity and compliance risk

l4_steps.name: Generate and extend conditional offer letter
l4_steps.input: Selection decision, approved salary band, confirmed start date
l4_steps.output: Digitally signed conditional offer letter with pre-employment conditions stated
l4_steps.kpi: Offer extended within 2 business days of selection decision; offer acceptance rate ≥85%
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP SuccessFactors salary band guardrails block above-band offers without a formal exception workflow — for experienced First Officers and A&P mechanics competing with legacy carrier packages (Delta, United), the exception approval cycle (5–7 days) causes candidate drop-off to competitors

l4_steps.name: Initiate background check and FAA PRIA records request
l4_steps.input: Signed offer letter; candidate consent form; FAA PRIA release authorisation (for pilot roles)
l4_steps.output: Background check clearance report; PRIA records request submitted and tracked
l4_steps.kpi: Background check completed within 7 business days; FAA PRIA response within 30 days (statutory maximum); 100% compliance with Air Carrier Access Act record-keeping
l4_steps.pain_point: FAA PRIA requests for internationally certified pilots (JAA/EASA licence holders converting to FAA ATP) require manual coordination with foreign civil aviation authorities — average response time is 45–60 days vs. the 30-day statutory target, blocking hire completion

l4_steps.name: Conduct DOT-mandated drug and alcohol screening
l4_steps.input: Offer acceptance confirmation; DOT 49 CFR Part 40 pre-employment testing requirement for safety-sensitive roles
l4_steps.output: MRO-verified drug test result (pass/fail); test documentation retained per DOT 5-year record requirement
l4_steps.kpi: Drug screen specimen collected within 3 business days of offer acceptance; 100% compliance rate for safety-sensitive roles (pilots, cabin crew, dispatchers, mechanics)
l4_steps.pain_point: DOT 49 CFR Part 40 requires direct-observation collection for certain re-hire categories — the LabCorp DOT collector network has limited presence in smaller airline base cities (ISP, BDL, MHT), requiring candidates to travel, causing 2–5 day delays and candidate attrition

l4_steps.name: Verify licences, certificates, and medical fitness
l4_steps.role: Talent Acquisition Specialist / Crew Compliance Officer
l4_steps.system: FAA IACRA (Integrated Airman Certification and Rating Application) / SAP SuccessFactors Document Management
l4_steps.input: Pilot: ATP certificate, type ratings, Class 1 FAA medical; Cabin crew: FAA initial certification; Tech ops: FAA A&P and IA licence
l4_steps.output: Verified credential record stored in SAP SuccessFactors employee file; compliance sign-off from Crew Compliance
l4_steps.kpi: 100% credential verification completed before Day 1; zero compliance exceptions at FAA CHDO audit; credential expiry alerts configured in SuccessFactors
l4_steps.pain_point: FAA IACRA public lookup does not have an API integration with SAP SuccessFactors — credential data must be manually transcribed, creating data entry error risk; errors discovered at FAA Certificate Holding District Office (CHDO) audit result in regulatory corrective action

l4_steps.name: Create employee record and provision system access
l4_steps.role: HR Operations Specialist / IT Service Desk
l4_steps.system: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central / ServiceNow (IT provisioning workflow)
l4_steps.input: Cleared pre-employment checks; confirmed start date and role
l4_steps.output: Active employee record in SAP SuccessFactors; network credentials and role-based system access granted via ServiceNow
l4_steps.kpi: System access provisioned and verified by 08:00 on Day 1; first-day access failure rate ≤1%
l4_steps.pain_point: ServiceNow-to-SuccessFactors integration triggers provisioning only on a nightly batch — new hire records created less than 48 hours before the start date miss the batch window and arrive on Day 1 without access, requiring manual IT escalation that averages 4–6 hours to resolve

l4_steps.name: Enrol new hire in orientation and mandatory training
l4_steps.role: HR Operations Specialist / Learning & Development Coordinator
l4_steps.input: Active employee record; role-specific training curriculum; FAA-required initial training schedule for safety-sensitive roles
l4_steps.output: Training assignments confirmed in LMS; Initial Operating Experience (IOE) scheduled for pilots; emergency procedures training scheduled for cabin crew; A&P recurrency training enrolled for maintenance technicians
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of mandatory Day-1 training assignments loaded before start date; regulatory training completion ≥95% within first 30 days; zero FAA compliance exceptions at training audit
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP SuccessFactors LMS does not auto-assign FAA-required recurrent training curricula (FAR Part 121 initial, emergency equipment, CRM) when a new employee record is created for safety-sensitive roles — manual curriculum assignment is required and is frequently missed during high-volume new hire cohorts, creating FAA Part 121 compliance gaps
